description: Case do NHÓM tự viết thêm để cover thêm trường hợp. Mỗi case cần: id, phase='B', query HOẶC turns, failure_type (thuộc allowed_failure_types), và expect (tool_calls[...] hoặc no_tool=true). Nên kèm metadata.what_it_tests.

cases.query: Lấy 3 tweet mới nhất từ tài khoản @karpathy.

metadata.what_it_tests: Chuẩn hóa username có @ thành screenname không có @ và giữ limit=3.

cases.query: Find the latest tweets about AI safety.

metadata.what_it_tests: Explicitly requested latest posts should route to social_search with search_type=Latest.

cases.query: Search GitHub issues for pandas nullable dtype bug.

metadata.what_it_tests: A request explicitly scoped to GitHub issues should use github_search rather than general web lookup.

cases.query: Thanks, that is all for now.

metadata.what_it_tests: A simple acknowledgment does not need a research or action tool.

cases.query: Show me the latest tweets from my account.

metadata.what_it_tests: The agent must ask for the account handle instead of guessing who 'my account' refers to.

turns.content: Actually, use this month instead of today.

metadata.what_it_tests: Apply the latest timeframe correction while retaining the AI news topic.

turns.content: Actually, make that the latest tweets.

metadata.what_it_tests: Use the corrected Latest sort instead of retaining the earlier Top sort.

turns.content: Search the web for news about OpenAI.
Use tweets instead, keeping the same topic.
